text:
Alex: FYI customers flagged intermittent double billing on streaming reconnects after a small region failover this morning. small sample shows provisional credits being replayed.
Rina: Can you drop the logs/trace? curious if this is the same GC->reattach class we've seen.
Alex: Snippet: ```2024-05-04T08:02:09Z INFO router: attach failed session=xyz789 reason=not_found
2024-05-04T08:02:09Z DEBUG ledger: provisional(session=xyz789, toolcall=tc-55, tokens=28) tombstone=none
2024-05-04T08:02:10Z INFO client: reconnect new_session=xyz790 reconnect_token=rt-9
2024-05-04T08:02:10Z DEBUG ledger: provisional(session=xyz790, toolcall=tc-55, tokens=28) -> apply confirmed
```
Devon: looks like router couldn't reconcile old session -> created new provisional row for same toolcall id. We end up confirming twice.
Kamal: Are we using client-supplied idempotency keys for streaming toolcalls? If not, that's part of the problem.
Alex: Clients send reconnect_token but we didn't consistently use it server-side for mid-stream dedupe. Also tombstone lifecycle on provisional rows is 20s which is too short for cross-region failovers.
Rina: Options: (A) extend provisional TTL for streaming sessions; (B) write tombstones with original reconnect_token so router can merge; (C) canonicalize on toolcall-id + reconnect_token at ledger level to make confirm idempotent.
Devon: (C) is safest for correctness but touches ledger write path and rollback semantics. (B) is lower-risk and lets router attempt reattach. (A) is simplest but just increases blast radius.
Kamal: Concern with (B): tombstones increase reads during routing and complicate compaction. Also we need to prevent tombstone abuse for long-running sessions. Maybe make tombstone sticky only for entries flagged streaming=true.
Alex: For console/ops: we currently only show final confirmed token totals. We should add a provisional column and a small timeline for provisional->confirmed churn so SRE can see spikes during a rollout.
ops-bot: ci-build: feature/ledger-merge -> staging deploy queued (id:2024-05-04-11) :rocket: 
Rina: Telemetry: add span tag `ledger.dedupe_hit=true/false` and metric `ledger.duplicate_confirm_attempts`. Also trace attribute `reattach_via` with values `reconnect_token`, `session_id`, `region_failover` to help filter.
Devon: Implementation plan proposal: initial PR implements (B) tombstone with reconnect_token + metric + router check. If staging soak looks good, follow-up PR for (C) idempotent confirm.
Kamal: UX: when feature flag is off, console should still show provisional totals (to help SREs during rollouts). Add an ops toggle to surface provisional rows for a customer.
Alex: I'll open GH issue with logs and link to billing-recon. Also schedule a 6hr staging soak with synthetic reconnects from other regions.
Rina: I'll own the tombstone PR and add compaction job to delete tombstones older than 5m if streaming=false, 2m if streaming=true.
Devon: Add alert: if duplicate_confirm_attempts > 5 for a route in 1m -> page.
Kamal: +1 to the alert. Also record rollback plan: rollback tombstone flag and fallback to TTL bump.
Alex: Action items:
- Rina: PR for tombstone+router-reattach (staging)
- Devon: add telemetry + alert rule
- Kamal: console mock for provisional column + ops toggle
- Alex: staging soak, open GH issue with traces (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/1483)
Rina: starting work now, will ping when staging deploy hits.
Alex: thanks all. We'll iterate based on soak metrics.
